demo_banner: Demo build — every record shown is fully synthetic placeholder data
demo_hint: Demo sign-in: demo_owner, demo_rep or demo_finance / password: Demo-2026 — see docs/CLIENT_DEMO.md
users_desc: Owner only: edit existing users, roles, activity and branches. No account creation or password changes.
users_session_note: Every effective change revokes all user sessions. Owner status and territory assignments cannot be changed here.
users_confirm: Save this user's access and revoke all their existing sessions?
users_saved: Access saved and audited; previous sessions revoked.
login_hint: Use your company account to reach the system.
home_desc: KPIs are fetched live from the isolated demo database — no invented numbers on this screen.
home_drafts_title: My drafts saved on this device
home_drafts_hint: Shortcut for this device only; each record reopens via the server (GET /invoices/{id}).
home_drafts_empty: No drafts registered on this device yet.
empty_rows: No data yet in the demo database (not implemented / no records).
draft_registry_cleaned: This draft was removed from the device list because the server no longer has it
draft_only_note: Drafts only — posting is disabled behind the safety gate; drafts never deduct stock or change receivables.
server_totals_note: The server recalculates totals and stores them as the authoritative record.
posting_disabled_hint: Posting is disabled by the safety gate (HTTP 409) — this demo never fakes a successful post.
draft_scope_note: Drafts do not deduct stock and do not touch receivables; impact posts only on posting.
err_line_incomplete: A line is incomplete: finish product/quantity or delete the row.
read_only_role: Read-only role — saving and editing are disabled in this demo.
demo_note_stock: Synthetic opening balances seated in the isolated demo DB — drafts never deduct them.
ledger_desc: Every recorded in/out movement with its source reference.
invoicelist_desc: Header snapshots from the server; open an invoice for its lines.
salesreport_desc: Posted invoices only: totals by territory, rep and product. Monetary amounts in EGP.
mgmtsummary_desc: Sales, collections and receivables from the real ledgers — replaces manual Excel consolidation. Monetary amounts in EGP.
sr_empty: No posted invoices in this period.
balances_note: Balance = sum of real ledger entries (posted invoices + synthetic openings − collections); saving a draft never changes it.
select_customer_ledger: Choose a customer to show their ledger
demo_note_receipts: Receipts are synthetic openings; the safety gate blocks creating/voiding new ones (409).
customers_desc: Manage customers by branch and territory. Inactive customers keep their history but cannot be used for new sales.
customer_confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this customer? Existing history will be preserved.
customer_confirm_reactivate: Reactivate this customer for new sales?
customer_references_required: An existing branch and territory are required before creating a customer.
customer_required: Enter the customer code and Arabic name.
customer_duplicate: This customer code already exists. Use a different code.
customer_reference_invalid: The selected branch or territory no longer exists. Close and reopen the form to reload the choices.
products_desc: The real product catalog with base price and VAT rate.
product_policy: Owner-only maintenance. Enter price and VAT explicitly when creating a product. Name edits do not change either value.
product_limit: First 500 matches shown; search to find another product.
product_decimal_hint: Use digits 0–9 and a decimal point, with at most two decimal places. VAT is a percentage from 0 to 100.
product_confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this product? Existing history will be preserved.
product_confirm_activate: Reactivate this product for new transactions?
product_required: Enter the SKU and Arabic name.
product_duplicate: This SKU already exists. Use a different SKU.
warehouses_desc: Registered branches and warehouses; the territory hierarchy (territories → areas → reps) below is labelled prototype.
suppliers_desc: The real supplier directory — fully synthetic data.
accounts_desc: Accounts actually registered in the COA (assets / liabilities / equity / revenue / expenses).
doctors_desc: The real doctor directory; the promotional-spend ledger below is labelled prototype.
visits_desc: Record customer-held stock and sell-through for one product per visit.
visit_save_note: Field observation only: no receipt is created and receivables or company stock are not changed.
visit_err_pick: Pick a customer and a product first.
visit_saved_locally: Visit saved on this device locally only (prototype).
visit_warn_st: Computed sell-through is negative — check the current stock.
p_org_note: Full hierarchy is specified in APP_FLOW B1; implementing territories/areas/reps needs a data model not built yet.
prototype_sample_note: Values here are illustrative only — not from the database or the server.
pwa_defer: Use in-browser; installing is optional depending on your OS
offline_yes: Offline now — UI works; data loads once back online
pwa_install_steps: Desktop (Chrome/Edge): the install button in the address bar, or the browser menu → “Install Medical Company System”.||Mobile (Android/Chrome): browser menu → “Add to Home screen”, then “Install”.||It also runs straight from the link as a normal web page — no app store needed.
pwa_note: PWA install is optional; this demo requires no app-store installation.
targets_desc: Rep targets by month (live server data).
batches_desc: Batch snapshots ordered by expiry (live data).
batches_empty_near_expiry: No near-expiry batches in your current access scope. Choose All batches to view the full list.
cover_desc: Cover days from real sales (live data).
invalerts_desc: Overstock and cover days from real movements and the approved inventory policy.
private_desc: Isolated internal ledger (D40): separate schema, owner-only access, independent audit — it never touches company AR or stock.
private_rule: Leave one side at zero; an entry with both values at zero is rejected.
supplier_confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this supplier? You can reactivate it later.
visit_saved_server: Visit saved on server. Ready for the next count.
visit_mode_note: This form records one product without a batch. Historical batch-specific observations remain separate.
visit_delete_confirm: Delete this visit and all its product lines? Customer-held stock will use the latest remaining observation.
visit_previous_loaded: Last recorded stock without a batch. Check it before saving.
visit_no_previous: No previous unbatched count. Enter the opening quantity if known.
visit_previous_error: Previous stock could not be loaded. Retry the selection or enter the quantity manually.
visit_save_uncertain: Save could not be confirmed. Refresh server history before retrying to avoid a duplicate visit.
visit_legacy_note: Old device-only prototype entries are retained on this device and are not imported automatically.
